metadata.question: Did Phoenix experienced a record 40 consecutive days in which the land surface temperature exceeded 110 degrees Fahrenheit in the summer of 2023?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy: Use MODIS daily land surface temperature collections MODIS/061/MOD11A1 (Terra) and MODIS/061/MYD11A1 (Aqua) from 2023-06-01 to 2023-09-30 over Phoenix city boundary (TIGER 2018 Places, buffered 5 km). Build a daily composite per day using the maximum of Terra/Aqua LST.
2. Masking strategy: Mask using QC_Day bits 0–1 <= 1 (produced, good/other quality). Scale LST to Kelvin (0.02). Keep masked pixels; count valid pixels per day to detect C2.
3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error: If collections are empty => C1. If valid pixel counts across all days are zero => C2. If any computed daily mean is NaN/invalid => C3. Otherwise compute max consecutive days where mean LST Fahrenheit > 110. Output A if >=40, else B.
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    var start = ee.Date('2023-06-01');
    var end = ee.Date('2023-09-30').advance(1, 'day'); // inclusive end
    var days = end.difference(start, 'day').toInt();
    var places = ee.FeatureCollection('TIGER/2018/Places')
      .filter(ee.Filter.eq('STATEFP', '04'))
      .filter(ee.Filter.eq('NAME', 'Phoenix'));
    var geom = ee.Algorithms.If(
      places.size().gt(0),
      ee.Feature(places.first()).geometry().buffer(5000),
      ee.Geometry.Point([-112.0740, 33.4484]).buffer(20000)
    );
    geom = ee.Geometry(geom);
    var cityKm2 = ee.Number(geom.area(1)).divide(1e6);

    // 2. Data Acquisition & Check
    function maskMOD11(img) {
      var qc = img.select('QC_Day');
      var good = qc.bitwiseAnd(3).lte(1);
      var lstK = img.select('LST_Day_1km').multiply(0.02).rename('LST');
      return lstK.updateMask(good).copyProperties(img, ['system:time_start']);
    }
    var terra = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD11A1').filterDate(start, end).map(maskMOD11);
    var aqua = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MYD11A1').filterDate(start, end).map(maskMOD11);
    var terraSize = await terra.size().getInfo();
    var aquaSize = await aqua.size().getInfo();

    if ((terraSize === 0) && (aquaSize === 0)) {
      console.log(`MOD11A1 images: ${terraSize}, MYD11A1 images: ${aquaSize}`);
      console.log('No images for the date/location.');
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }

    var merged = terra.merge(aqua);

    // 3. Daily composites and stats per day
    var dayList = ee.List.sequence(0, days.subtract(1)).map(function (d) {
      d = ee.Number(d);
      var day = start.advance(d, 'day');
      var next = day.advance(1, 'day');
      var dailyIC = merged.filterDate(day, next);
      var dailyImg = ee.Image(ee.Algorithms.If(
        dailyIC.size().gt(0),
        ee.ImageCollection(dailyIC).max(),
        ee.Image(0).updateMask(ee.Image(0)).rename('LST')
      )).set('date', day.format('YYYY-MM-dd')).set('system:time_start', day.millis());

      var stats = dailyImg.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }),
        geometry: geom,
        scale: 1000,
        maxPixels: 1e9,
        bestEffort: true
      });
      var meanK = ee.Number(stats.get('LST_mean'));
      var count = ee.Number(stats.get('LST_count'));
      return ee.Feature(null, {
        date: day.format('YYYY-MM-dd'),
        meanK: meanK,
        count: count
      });
    });

    var dailyFC = ee.FeatureCollection(dayList);
    var dailyInfo = await dailyFC.aggregate_array('date').getInfo();
    var meansK = await dailyFC.aggregate_array('meanK').getInfo();
    var counts = await dailyFC.aggregate_array('count').getInfo();

    // 4. Client-side validation and consecutive run calculation
    const toF = k => k * 9 / 5 - 459.67;
    let validDays = 0, overDays = 0, maxRun = 0, curRun = 0;
    let runStart = null, runEnd = null, bestStart = null, bestEnd = null;
    let minCount = Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY, sumCount = 0, validCountDays = 0;
    let invalidValue = false;

    for (let i = 0; i < dailyInfo.length; i++) {
      const date = dailyInfo[i];
      const k = meansK[i];
      const c = counts[i] || 0;
      if (c > 0) {
        validDays += 1;
        validCountDays += 1;
        sumCount += c;
        if (c < minCount) minCount = c;
        if (k === null || k === undefined || !isFinite(k)) { invalidValue = true; }
        const f = toF(k);
        if (!isFinite(f) || f < -100 || f > 200) { invalidValue = true; }
        const over = f > 110;
        if (over) {
          overDays += 1;
          if (curRun === 0) runStart = date;
          curRun += 1;
          runEnd = date;
          if (curRun > maxRun) { maxRun = curRun; bestStart = runStart; bestEnd = runEnd; }
        } else {
          curRun = 0;
          runStart = null;
        }
      } else {
        // No valid pixels -> breaks any ongoing run
        curRun = 0;
        runStart = null;
      }
    }

    console.log(`MOD11A1 images: ${terraSize}, MYD11A1 images: ${aquaSize}`);
    console.log(`Date range: ${dailyInfo[0]} to ${dailyInfo[dailyInfo.length - 1]} (days: ${dailyInfo.length})`);
    console.log(`Phoenix area ~ ${Math.round((await cityKm2.getInfo()) * 10) / 10} km^2`);
    if (validDays === 0) {
      console.log('Valid days with pixels: 0');
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }
    if (invalidValue) {
      console.log('Calculation produced invalid values (NaN/out-of-range).');
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }
    const avgCount = Math.round((sumCount / Math.max(1, validCountDays)) * 10) / 10;
    console.log(`Valid days with pixels: ${validDays}/${dailyInfo.length}, avg valid px/day: ${avgCount}, min: ${minCount}`);
    console.log(`Days with mean LST > 110°F: ${overDays}`);
    if (maxRun > 0) {
      console.log(`Max consecutive run >110°F: ${maxRun} days (${bestStart} to ${bestEnd})`);
    } else {
      console.log('Max consecutive run >110°F: 0 days');
    }

    // 5. Final answer
    if (maxRun >= 40) {
      console.log('A');
    } else {
      console.log('B');
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.log(`Error: ${err}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
